title: My first weeks in Dublin
summary_es: Un correo desde Dublín. Preposiciones, relativos, pronombres y formas de futuro.
text: I arrived in Dublin three weeks {{1}}, and I'm already in love with the city. I'm staying with a host family {{2}} live near the sea. They are very kind, although I don't always understand everything they say! Every morning I {{3}} to get up at seven because my English class starts at half past eight. There are twelve students in my class, and most of {{4}} come from Spain or Italy. After class we usually go to a café together. Yesterday we went {{5}} a walk along the river, and tomorrow we are {{6}} to visit a famous castle. I can't wait!

gaps.explanation_es: «Three weeks ago» = hace tres semanas. «Ago» va detrás del tiempo y pide past simple.
Relativo de persona como sujeto: who (o that). Aquí no se puede omitir.
Obligación: have to + infinitivo. «Need to» también vale.
Tras una preposición (of) va el pronombre de objeto: most of them.
Expresión fija: «go for a walk» = dar un paseo.
Plan decidido: be going to + infinitivo.
